Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in scientific fact retrieval and comparison. It incorrectly stated that a neutron has less mass than an electron (~8.5e-32 kg vs ~9.11e-31 kg). In reality, a neutron (~1.675e-27 kg) is significantly heavier than an electron (~9.109e-31 kg), roughly 1839 times heavier. Consequently, the Planner's reasoning led to the wrong conclusion (C) instead of the correct answer (A), which is the electron. This error stems from a hallucination of physical constants and a failure to correctly order the masses of subatomic particles.
